create_camera_sensor: create a CameraSensorSpec to configure a camera sensor with width, height, and horizontal FOV for habitat-sim
build_audio_sensor: build an AudioSensorSpec to configure binaural audio capture with RLRAudioPropagationConfiguration in habitat-sim
create_fisheye_sensor: create a FisheyeSensorSpec with FisheyeSensorModelType to configure a fisheye lens sensor in habitat-sim
use_sensor_factory: use SensorFactory to programmatically create Sensor instances from a SensorSpec configuration object
configure_equirectangular_sensor: configure an EquirectangularSensorSpec to capture 360-degree equirectangular panoramic images in habitat-sim
